name: Skill Discovery Template
description: Profession spells that can be discovered while crafting: casting the requirement spell gives a chance to learn the discovered spell once the required skill value is reached. Loaded by SpellMgr::LoadSkillDiscoveryTable.

fields.name: Requirement Spell
fields.help: Spell whose cast can trigger the discovery (0 = any spell of the skill line).

fields.name: Req Skill Value
fields.help: Minimum skill value required to discover the spell.

fields.name: Chance
fields.help: Discovery chance, scaled by Rate.Skill.Discovery config.
